resolution.note: fast selects the index test; generator degrades within budget

title: Adding a src module never fails CI on the capability-index budget and fast runs the index test
body:
Why: the capability-index 9500-character budget failed the first CI Check in three lanes on 2026-11-14 (deploy-safe #780, adopt-init #786, flaky-base #790): npm run fast rewrites docs/generated/capability-index.md but does not select test/claude/capability-index.test.ts, so the overflow surfaces only in CI; lanes then shortened module headers by hand.
Outcome: npm run fast selects the capability-index test whenever the regenerated index or any src module header changes, and the index generator degrades deterministically (shortens or drops the lowest-value lines it already ranks) instead of exceeding the budget, so adding a module never fails CI on budget alone.
Proof: fast-check selectTests test for the index; capability-index test with a synthetic src over budget; npm run fast PASS.
